findings.claim: The declared objective is final predicted target affinity as primary, with validity and strain secondary and coordinate control only; the reward view is the endpoint pointcloud with a detached-Hungarian endpoint mean squared distance and native endpoint VJP, so no affinity-head derivative or extra model forward is available as evidence.

Observed score times span the full learning window [0.0, 0.5] at 0.01 spacing (50 nodes), and the label semantics state recorded affinities were removed with an equal score prior; therefore no observed affinity label exists in this packet and no last-record or terminal credit can be presented as final affinity benefit.

Continuous contrast functions are reported only as observed-node linear fits over the observed support with extrapolation_allowed=false and polynomial_accepted=false for every row read; several landmark features show multiple sign changes and strong sign conflicts (e.g. landmark_00_local_dz has 10 sign changes and 7 strong sign conflicts; landmark_00_local_dx has 6 sign changes and 9 strong sign conflicts), so a constant rule is not supported and any time-conditioned rule must stay within the observed nodes.

Fit fidelity varies strongly across landmark features: relative_node_RMSE ranges from about 0.29 (landmark_00_soft_mass) to about 0.78 (landmark_00_local_dx), so low-RMSE features are the only ones where a smooth observed-node contrast curve is credible, while high-RMSE features should be treated as noisy marginal descriptors.

Whole-window z values for the read landmark features are small in magnitude (about -0.58 to +0.64) while first/last rate z values are large (e.g. -72.4 and +5.5 for landmark_00_local_dy), indicating that endpoint rate estimates are unstable and that whole-window mean contrasts, not endpoint rates, are the more defensible summary.

hypotheses.falsifier: A constant regional weight achieves equal or lower relative_node_RMSE on the same observed nodes, or the time-conditioned rule requires values outside the observed support.
hypotheses.observable: relative_node_RMSE and sign_changes of the landmark contrast under observed-node interpolation
hypotheses.scope: observed score nodes 0.0-0.5 only; no extrapolation
hypotheses.statement: A time-conditioned regional attention rule that follows the validated observed-node contrast of a low-RMSE landmark feature (e.g. landmark_00_soft_mass) will track the observed contrast better than a constant regional weight, without extrapolating beyond the observed score nodes.

hypotheses.falsifier: A high-sign-conflict feature shows a stable, reproducible whole-window contrast with consistent sign across independent batches.
hypotheses.scope: landmark local derivative features over the observed window
hypotheses.statement: High-sign-conflict landmark features (e.g. landmark_00_local_dz, landmark_00_local_dx) carry marginal, unstable contrast information and should not be used as direction priorities for coordinate control.

limitations: No observed affinity labels are present (recorded affinities removed, equal score prior), so selection enrichment, descendant survival credit and final affinity benefit cannot be compared or claimed.

No decoded terminal labels, lineage survival or turnover accounting rows were read in this turn; the requested immediate-versus-descendant comparison and parent-child increment residual analysis remain unavailable.

No joint_diagnostics, regional_effects, branch_adjusted or information_audit rows were read, so multiplicity-adjusted support, coverage ranking and local-versus-global pose separation could not be evaluated.
Continuous trends are observed-node linear fits with extrapolation disallowed; no validated polynomial or time-binned rule is supported by the evidence read.
The endpoint pointcloud reward is a coordinate contrast, not a physical interaction energy or evidence of neural-module causation.
